title: Cap the active test-run rail badge display at 99
outcome: Cap the active test-run rail badge display at 99
acceptance: When 100 or more test runs are active, the rail badge displays 99 while its accessible name and tooltip retain the exact active-run count.
Counts below 100 and the zero-active-run state retain their existing display behavior.
